adv.fishing.root.desc: Discover the fish that inhabit this world
adv.fishing.catch_fish.desc: Catch a fish with a fishing rod
adv.fishing.catch_junk.desc: Catch junk with a fishing rod
adv.fishing.catch_treasure.desc: Catch treasure with a fishing rod
fish.fishing.axolotl.desc: An adorable amphibian that looked at evolution and said, "Nah, I'm good like this."
fish.fishing.fish_bones.desc: Proof that the fish got away, but its skeleton had the decency to stay behind.
fish.fishing.humpback_whitefish.desc: A chilly fish with a hump on its back and absolutely no plans to move somewhere warmer.
fish.fishing.alaska_blackfish.desc: A tiny Alaskan survivor that treats freezing temperatures like a minor inconvenience.
fish.fishing.spoonhead_sculpin.desc: A tiny bottom dweller with a head shaped like someone dropped a spoon on its face.
fish.fishing.northern_pike.desc: A patient ambush predator that can turn "just a peaceful pond" into a horror movie.
fish.fishing.siberian_sturgeon.desc: An ancient Siberian giant that has been around so long it probably remembers when the water was new.
fish.fishing.striped_perch.desc: A striped swimmer dressed for an underwater gala that nobody else was invited to.
fish.fishing.crappie.desc: A fish with an unfortunate name and the confidence to be delicious anyway.
fish.fishing.walleye.desc: Those weird reflective eyes aren't a fashion statement. They're basically built-in night vision.
fish.fishing.gar.desc: An armored prehistoric fish that looks like it missed the memo about which millennium it lives in.
fish.fishing.muskellunge.desc: A freshwater predator so impressive that everyone just calls it a muskie, because apparently its full name is too powerful.
fish.fishing.bluegill.desc: A colorful little sunfish that looks innocent right up until it steals your bait and leaves.
fish.fishing.carp.desc: A hardy freshwater fish that survives almost anything, including fishing attempts that should have worked.
fish.fishing.catfish.desc: A whiskered fish with no cat, no interest in climbing trees, and an excellent relationship with the bottom.
fish.fishing.bass.desc: A powerful freshwater predator and the reason many anglers can turn "just one cast" into an entire afternoon.
fish.fishing.mediterranean_killifish.des: A tiny fish with a name that sounds like it has a very specific appointment with destiny.
fish.fishing.freshwater_pufferfish.desc: A tiny fish that responds to danger by becoming a spiky balloon. Honestly, fair.
fish.fishing.lamprey.desc: An ancient jawless fish with a mouth that looks like nature invented a suction cup and gave it teeth vibes.
fish.fishing.tunisian_barb.desc: A hardy little fish from North Africa that has mastered the ancient art of simply not dying.
fish.fishing.european_eel.desc: A mysterious fish that spends its life traveling between rivers and oceans, because apparently one neighborhood wasn't enough.
fish.fishing.guppy.desc: A tiny colorful fish that can turn a peaceful aquarium into a rapidly expanding apartment complex.
fish.fishing.bujurqui.desc: A South American cichlid proving once again that small fish can have absolutely enormous personalities.
fish.fishing.piranha.desc: A famous freshwater predator with terrifying teeth and a reputation that may be doing most of the work.
fish.fishing.armoured_catfish.desc: A whiskered bottom dweller wearing natural armor like it expects a boss fight at any moment.
fish.fishing.arapaima.desc: One of the world's biggest freshwater fish, because apparently regular-sized fish weren't impressive enough.
fish.fishing.cod.desc: A cold-water classic that has been feeding people for centuries and still hasn't asked for a raise.
fish.fishing.salmon.desc: A determined fish that swims upstream, fights rapids, and refuses to accept that "going back" is a bad idea.
fish.fishing.herring.desc: A small silver fish that travels in enormous groups because apparently personal space is overrated.
fish.fishing.wolffish.desc: A cold-water predator with jaws and teeth that make it look like it has unresolved business with the ocean.
fish.fishing.skate.desc: A flat relative of rays that glides along the seafloor like an aquatic carpet with somewhere to be.
fish.fishing.black_seabass.desc: A sturdy coastal predator that spends its days hunting around reefs and rocky hideouts.
fish.fishing.monkfish.desc: An ugly ambush predator that waves a little lure around and lets dinner come to it. Peak laziness, honestly.
fish.fishing.opah.desc: A brilliantly colored fish that can keep much of its body warmer than the surrounding water. Basically wearing its own heated blanket.
fish.fishing.anchovy.desc: A tiny silver fish that travels in enormous schools and somehow manages to be both small and extremely important.
fish.fishing.shad.desc: A schooling fish famous for seasonal migrations and the stubborn determination to make the trip every year.
fish.fishing.flying_fish.desc: It doesn't technically fly, but it launches out of the water and glides far enough to make the distinction feel petty.
fish.fishing.sturgeon.desc: An ancient armored fish that grows enormous and looks like it was downloaded from the prehistoric DLC.
fish.fishing.swordfish.desc: A powerful ocean predator carrying a giant sword on its face, because apparently subtlety was never an option.
fish.fishing.rainbow_wrasse.desc: A reef fish so colorful it looks like someone spilled an entire box of crayons into the ocean.
fish.fishing.gurnard.desc: A strange bottom dweller with leg-like fins that make it look dangerously close to discovering walking.
fish.fishing.flounder.desc: A fish that grows up to swim sideways and somehow ends up with both eyes on the same side. Problem solved, apparently.
fish.fishing.mahi_mahi.desc: A fast, colorful ocean predator that looks like it got dressed by a very enthusiastic artist.
fish.fishing.painted_moray.desc: A boldly patterned reef eel with a permanent expression of "Go ahead. Make my day."
fish.fishing.oarfish.desc: A giant ribbon-shaped deep-sea fish that looks less like dinner and more like something sailors invented after seeing a nightmare.
fish.fishing.pale_fish.desc: A pale fish from the Pale Garden that looks like it hasn't seen sunlight since the beginning of time.
fish.fishing.echo_fish.desc: A mysterious eel from the Deep Dark that seems perfectly happy living somewhere every noise sounds ten times scarier.
item.fishing.axolotl.desc: You were fishing for fish. The axolotl has decided that technicalities are beneath it.
block.fishing.bamboo.desc: Not a fish. Not even remotely a fish. Your fishing rod is apparently branching into gardening.
item.fishing.bowl.desc: An empty bowl suggesting the fish either escaped or was never invited to dinner.
item.fishing.fishing_rod.desc: An old fishing rod recovered from the depths. Somewhere, another fisherman is wondering where this went.
item.fishing.fish_bones.desc: The fish escaped. Its skeleton apparently wasn't fast enough.
item.fishing.frog.desc: You were aiming for a fish and somehow caught a frog. Fishing has become less specific.
item.fishing.ink_sac.desc: A suspiciously inky package from something that clearly wanted to leave no witnesses.
item.fishing.leather.desc: Not a fish, not treasure, but apparently the ocean's idea of a participation prize.
block.fishing.lily_pad.desc: A perfectly good lily pad. Not edible, not a fish, but excellent if you suddenly need pond furniture.
item.fishing.stick.desc: The ultimate fishing treasure: a stick. Nature's way of saying, "Better luck next cast."
item.fishing.string.desc: Either a very unlucky spider or a fisherman having an unusually successful day.
item.fishing.tadpole.desc: Tiny, wiggly, and very much not ready to become dinner. Give it a few upgrades first.
block.fishing.tripwire_hook.desc: Someone lost a trap, and your fishing rod apparently decided to become a detective.
item.fishing.water_bottle.desc: You went fishing and caught water. Technically a flawless catch. Nobody said it had to be interesting.
item.fishing.enchanted_book.desc: A mysterious enchanted book pulled from the water. Hopefully the magic works better when dry.
block.fishing.chest.desc: Someone buried a fortune down here and thought putting TNT next to the diamonds was perfectly reasonable.
item.fishing.crystal_heart.desc: A mysterious crystal treasure that looks far too important to have been sitting at the bottom of a lake.
item.fishing.emerald.desc: An ancient coin dredged from the depths. Either treasure, or someone's very expensive mistake.
item.fishing.enchanted_fishing_rod.desc: An enchanted fishing rod recovered from the depths. Even legendary fishermen apparently lose their gear.
item.fishing.nautilus_shell.desc: A beautiful shell from the depths, because the ocean apparently leaves souvenirs.
fish.fishing.tropical_fish.desc: A brilliantly colorful reef fish available in more patterns than anyone reasonably needs.
fish.fishing.pufferfish.desc: A normally small fish that turns into a spiky balloon the moment things get awkward.
block.fishing.pale_hanging_moss.desc: Pale Garden moss hanging overhead like the forest has grown an impressive collection of spooky curtains.
item.fishing.resin_clump.desc: A sticky orange clump of resin from the Pale Garden. Congratulations, you caught tree goo.
block.fishing.sculk_vein.desc: A strange Deep Dark growth that spreads across surfaces like living darkness with absolutely no respect for personal space.
item.fishing.echo_shard.desc: A mysterious shard from an ancient city, carrying the echoes of the Deep Dark and probably several bad decisions.
